entities.summary: Nils Lundkvist is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Dallas Stars of the National Hockey League (NHL). Lundkvist was selected in the first round, 28th overall, of the 2018 NHL entry draft by the New York Rangers.
